statistical_rigor.notes: Fisher's exact and chi2 (Yates-corrected) run on every eligible (>=30/>=30) cell; statistically_significant programmatically verified to equal fisher_significant AND chi2_significant with 0 violations; low_confidence cells clearly separated from statistically supported ones in report Section 4.

completeness_of_breakdowns.notes: All 5 job roles (Software Engineer, QA Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager, Engineering Manager) and all 5 protected attributes covered individually (Section 2) plus a full ALL_ROLES rollup per dimension (Section 3).

clarity_of_findings.notes: Section 4 flagged-items table cites role, dimension, group, ratio, both p-values, significance, and confidence for all 22 flagged rows; no need to cross-reference the CSV to understand severity.

actionability_of_recommendations.notes: Recommendations name specific role/group/metric combinations (e.g. Software Engineer Hispanic/Latino ratio 0.43 p<0.02) and explicitly distinguish investigate vs. collect-more-data vs. monitor.

appropriate_caveats_and_tone.notes: Section 6 explicitly separates statistical disparity from proof of discrimination, flags the conservative dual-test bar, notes synthetic-data status; report language uses 'flagged'/'warrants review' throughout, never 'proven'.

factual_self_consistency.notes: Independent re-derivation from disparity_metrics.csv found zero discrepancies: true_flagged_count (22) matches the report's stated count exactly, and the true top-5-by-ratio tuples match Section 4's first five table rows in the same order with matching ratios and p-values.
